metadata.scenario: A manager asks for a detailed quote on spa treatments for an upcoming corporate retreat. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I hope you're doing well. I'm doing great, Agnes! How about you? I'm okay, thanks. I'm calling because I need a detailed quote for some spa treatments for an upcoming corporate retreat. Absolutely, I can help with that. Could you tell me how many participants you’re expecting? We’re looking at about 15 people. The retreat will be next month. Perfect! Do you have specific treatments in mind, or should I suggest a package? I was thinking of massages and maybe some relaxation therapies. Sounds good. We can offer a few options. Our massages start at $110 for a 60-minute session. Okay, that’s within our budget. What about relaxation therapies? We have aromatherapy and guided meditation, priced at $80 for 45 minutes. Those sound nice. Can you also provide any special group rates? Yes, for groups of 10 or more, we can offer a 10% discount on the total package. That would be great! Can you send me a breakdown of the total costs? Sure! I’ll summarize the massage and relaxation therapy rates, including the group discount. Thank you! Is there a minimum time we need to book for these treatments? Yes, we typically require at least two hours for the services to be effective. Got it. And do you have any special arrangements for post-treatment care? We can provide light refreshments and relaxation aids if needed, at an additional cost. That would be a nice touch! Please include that in the quote. Certainly! I’ll make a note of that. Would you like me to follow up with an email or a call? An email would be perfect. My address is the same as my contact number. Great! I’ll get the quote to you by the end of the day. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You're welcome, Agnes! If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out. Will do. Have a great day! You too! Take care.
